official_contracts.title: SetWindowPos
official_contracts.scope: Native HWND_BOTTOM operation and independent native BOOL result; no user-app-only filtering guarantee.

official_contracts.title: GetWindow
official_contracts.scope: Raw next/previous relationship within native Z order, not a list of eligible ordinary applications.

official_contracts.title: GetShellWindow
official_contracts.scope: Actual Shell desktop handle; NULL when no Shell. Use actual identity, not guessed class/name.
